one_line: Business is growing fast, but the market fears Waymo and Tesla will skip Uber. Waymo is already large without Uber, so the fear is partly earned.

why_fell.evidence: Waymo told Uber it will launch its own app in Austin and Atlanta in January 2028. The Phoenix partnership ended in June or July. Shares fell about 4% to a one-year low.
Tesla opened driverless Cybercab rides in Austin on Sept 3. Uber shares fell roughly 3.5% to 4% on fears of a rival network that bypasses Uber.

why_fell.reason: Long slide from the October 2025 record
why_fell.evidence: By early August the stock was down 28% from its $100.10 record while the Nasdaq 100 rose 19%. Waymo deal collapse weighed on sentiment.

why_fell.reason: Heavy spending and soft guidance worry some investors
why_fell.evidence: Q3 non-GAAP EPS of $0.88 reportedly missed a $0.90 estimate. Some commentary asks whether costs can keep pace with bookings.

for_unfair.point: Q3 2026 gross bookings rose 20% to $59.8B. Free cash flow was $2.5B, up 14%. Trips rose 16% to 4.1B. Active consumers rose 14% to 215M.
for_unfair.source: Uber Q3 2026 press release (via Seeking Alpha)

for_unfair.point: Uber's role is a many-partner platform. Live partners include Waymo (Austin, Atlanta), Avride, May Mobility, Motional and WeRide. CEO expects about 700 driverless vehicles by year-end and 2,000-plus in 2027.
Wells Fargo says self-driving effects on Uber are a 2027-and-beyond story, kept Overweight, target $95. Jefferies called the weakness an attractive entry point (headline only).

for_fair.point: Waymo already runs in about 11 US metro areas without Uber and does over 500,000 paid rides a week. The red-flag event is partly happening. Waymo seeks to exit its Uber contract.
Analysts cut ratings on robotaxi risk: Daiwa to Neutral citing costly fixed-asset robotaxi models, Melius to Sell, Arete to Neutral. Dates in the summary were unclear.
Insurance is a big cost. Uber carries $13.7B of insurance reserves and booked $484M of legal and regulatory charges in Q3. Critics say reserves are being used to fund robotaxis.
for_fair.source: Uber Q3 2026 press release; Consumer Watchdog

what_market_fears: Waymo and Tesla sell rides in their own apps, so Uber becomes a minor reseller and loses the profit on rides as driverless cars spread.
what_would_prove_it_wrong: Mobility bookings keep growing near 18% while partner fleets pass 2,000 cars in 2027, and Waymo or Tesla stay limited to a few cities.
next_date_to_watch: Q4 2026 results, expected early February 2027; year-end count of driverless vehicles on Uber versus the 700 target.

flag.note: Waymo is already large without Uber and plans its own app in Austin and Atlanta in 2028. Uber's bookings are still growing 20%, so no visible damage yet.

not_found: Tesla's current Cybercab fleet size and Waymo's current weekly rides (sources stop near 500,000 in early 2026). Insurance cost trend in Q3 not broken out. Jefferies note not read. Brief says 29% below high; Bloomberg cites a $100.10 record, which implies about 35% at $64.70.
